text:
Maria: FYI — small subset of trial + renewal tenants in EU/APAC seeing degraded embeddings and intermittent 503s after last night's config rollout. Treating as SLA exception. Working mitigation + CX comms. @Sam, can you post a short cause summary?

Sam: Quick cause summary — routing flag change for model pinning was rolled out without a prewarm step. Autoscaler routed traffic to cold dedicated nodes; those nodes hit memory pressure and evicted KV cache entries. Result: a spike of 503s/timeouts for embeddings endpoints for affected tenants. Mitigation plan: 1) pin affected requests back to hosted pool 2) add prewarm workers + bump up warm pool size 3) temporary routing rule to avoid cold nodes. I'll open a runbook PR now.

Lee: What do we want to tell customers? Do we offer credits or a trial extension for trials?

Maria: Draft offer I'm proposing — feedback welcome: 14-day trial extension for affected trials, and a $200 service credit (or equivalent local currency) for paid accounts impacted during the window. For high-touch renewals we loop AMs before sending.

Jenna: OK to proceed with that offer. For renewals, AM signoff required. Also recommend scheduling an office hours drop-in for affected accounts later today so customers can get live help and enablement. Tentative time: 10:30 PT.

Sam: Mitigation ETA ~25m. I'm creating a temporary routing rule and prewarm job. Will post status here.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated by sam at 2025-04-18T02:22:00Z — status: in_progress

Lee: I'll start drafting targeted messages for high-touch customers and queue the ones that require AM approval. Can someone share the exact list of affected tenants?

Maria: I'm pulling the list now and will upload a CSV to the CS drive (internal link). Quick heads-up — flagged renewal risk for these 3: Acme Retail, BetaPlatform, RetailX Labs. Please treat them as high priority.

Sam: Mitigation update: temporary routing rule applied, prewarm jobs started, error rate down ~78% vs peak. Monitoring for stability.

Maria: Customer-facing draft below — please suggest edits. Will only send after AM ok for renewals.

--- begin draft ---
Hi —
We wanted to let you know about a service disruption that affected embeddings requests for a small group of customers in EU/APAC between 02:10–02:55 UTC. The issue was caused by an internal routing change that routed requests to cold nodes without a prewarm step, which led to increased errors.

What we did: rolled routing back, prewarmed capacity, and applied temporary safeguards to prevent recurrence.
What we’re offering: a 14-day extension for active trials and a $200 service credit for affected paid accounts. If you need immediate assistance, we’re hosting office hours today at 10:30 PT — reply to this thread and we’ll reserve a slot.

We’re very sorry for the disruption. Your Account Manager will follow up if you’re on a renewal cadence.

Best,
Maria on behalf of Redwood Inference
--- end draft ---

Jenna: LGTM. Add a short line that we’ll follow up with RCAs within 72hrs.

Maria: Added RCA ETA. Finalizing and will post to high-touch customers after AM signoff.

Lee: Queued messages for the high-touch list, pending AM approvals.

Sam: Runbook PR created: ops/runbooks/2025-04-18-sla-exception-routing.md (internal).

Maria: Thank you all. I’ll track outbound responses in the CS tracker and update this thread with any escalations.

Lee: Noted — will ping AMs for the 3 flagged renewals.

Sam: Mitigation complete — routing stable, error rate back to baseline. Follow-up patches scheduled.

Maria: Sending comms to affected list now (high-touch paused for AM signoff). Will log credits and extensions after confirmations. :heart:

Lee: Thanks — standing by for AM feedback.
